title: An architecture-independent dissipation floor for alternating-renewal observations
description:
Unrefereed mathematical candidate. For finite-realizable stationary ergodic two-label alternating-renewal laws, zero unrestricted finite-architecture dissipation cost is equivalent to hyperexponential complete dwell laws and a finite reversible exact realization. The inherited equilibrium spectral restriction is explicitly credited; the additional closure conclusion allows unbounded hidden dimension and rates.

A bounded-persistence certificate yields V_infinity(P_1/20) > 0.017568198744. The fixed-window extension was suggested by the supplied model-review audit. Version 1.1 also adds an exact high-variance example, a deterministic observational-error corollary and a one-way-edge software repair. The positive optimum, its attainment and statistical confidence construction remain unresolved. Ordinary even-variable reversal, stationary finite CTMCs and deterministic observation are essential. Internal replay and model review are not external peer review, formal verification or exhaustive priority assurance. Original prose/data CC0-1.0; original code MIT.
